breakdown.description: The sinusoidal right-edge traction is evaluated with x on the boundary x = 1 instead of with the specified vertical coordinate
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly evaluates the sinusoidal traction using the vertical coordinate y: 't_y(y) = −6000*sin(4*pi*y) Pa', matching the ground truth load expression σ_yy = -6000*sin(4πy). It does not repeat the error of using x instead of y as the argument to the sine function.
